🚨 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti on Ekhator: "I see him as a penalty-box striker, a physical forward who attacks space and can turn difficult balls into playable ones."

🚨 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti: "I can’t play those two [Nick and Kolo Muani] together all the time, especially with matches on Sunday, Thursday and Sunday. We have a crucial league game on Sunday, so I need to be able to change things around
🚨 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti: "Hopefully, Ekhator can show us he has qualities that others might lack, giving us more options to rotate
🚨 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti: "I’ve never spoken badly about Woltemade or Kolo Muani. I’ve always spoken positively about them. We’re simply talking about a specific characteristic."

🚨 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti: "Physical presence is a way to gain territory when opponents press us aggressively. There are two players who can help us turn any situation around: the goalkeeper and the number nine."
🚨 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti: "Physical presence isn’t just about scoring goals. It also helps us hold the ball when the game becomes tight."
🚨 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti: "We’re looking at whether we can find that profile within the squad. Nico Gonzalez can also play as a striker; he has the qualities of a number nine
🚨 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti: "Jeff Ekhator made several appearances last season, although he didn’t play many full games. He’s a promising player and is now in better physical condition."
🚨 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti: "You say Woltemade doesn’t appeal to me, suggesting we lack a physical profile. If Jeff Ekhator shows he has what it takes, we already have those qualities in the squad."

🚨 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti: "I tried Kolo Muani in that position again because I need him there [as a striker]. I have very good wingers, and I believe I can use Kolo there again, as I did against Venezia. Woltemade cannot play every game."

‼️ 🇮🇹 LUCIANO SPALLETTI TO ASSESS JEFF EKHATOR BEFORE SIGNING A NEW STRIKER IN JANUARY Luciano Spalletti will evaluate Jeff Ekhator over the coming weeks. The young striker will be given opportunities to demonstrate whether the profile Spalletti is looking for — a physically imposing centre-forward — is already available within the squad. Should the right opportunity arise on the transfer market under favourable conditions, the Bianconeri will remain attentive and look to satisfy the coach’s request for an attacking reinforcement. However, Juventus cannot make new signings without corresponding player departures. The club must carefully manage both squad registration requirements and Financial Fair Play (FFP) restrictions, two significant factors that cannot be overlooked when planning their January transfer business. ⚪️ ⚫️ 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — DiMarzio SkySport

The young Italian forward could benefit from a loan move that would allow him to gain more consistent playing time and continue his development. A possible destination could be a club fighting to avoid relegation and looking to strengthen its attacking options.
